note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a TIM 12, NR 12-15; A06b TIM 12, NR 12-16; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: Generally applicable provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory only on the condition the dataset states; by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Constituição da República Democrática de Timor-Leste, Government of Timor-Leste portal PDF, art. 3. It confirmed birth in the territory and descent. It was silent on the years of residence, renunciation and loss on taking another citizenship, which still rest on the sources above, re-read that day and found the same.

sources.title: Constituição da República Democrática de Timor-Leste, Government of Timor-Leste portal PDF, art. 3
sources.said: Artigo 3.º (Cidadania) 1. Na República Democrática de Timor-Leste existe cidadania originária e cidadania adquirida. 2. São cidadãos originários de Timor-Leste, desde que tenham nascido em território nacional: a) Os filhos de pai ou mãe nascidos em Timor-Leste; b) Os filhos de pais incógnitos, apátridas ou de nacionalidade desconhecida; c) Os filhos de pai ou mãe estrangeiros que, sendo maiores de dezassete anos, declarem, por si, querer ser timorenses. 3. São cidadãos originários de Timor-Leste, ainda que nascidos em território estrangeiro, os filhos de pai ou mãe timorenses. 4. A aquisição, perda e reaquisição de cidadania, bem como o seu registo e prova, são regulados por lei.

atBirth.soilIf: Person is born in Timor-Leste to a person also born there.
